templates.name: Recruiter — request an interview
templates.whenToUse: A recruiter covering the target role; prefer university recruiting for student opportunities.
templates.subject: [Relevant background] — [Role] at [Company]
templates.message:
Hi [First name],

I’m [Name], a [brief background] interested in [Role, linked]. At [organization/project], I [specific achievement and result].

[Specific company/team work] interests me because [connection to my experience or interests].

Could we start the interview process for this role?

Thanks,
[Name]

templates.name: Existing connection — ask for a referral
templates.whenToUse: The candidate actually knows the recipient.
templates.subject: Referral for [Role] at [Company]
templates.message:
Hi [First name],

[Brief, genuine reference to your relationship.]

I found [Role, linked] at [Company]. The focus on [requirement] matches my experience [specific achievement], and I’m interested in [specific team work].

Would you feel comfortable referring me? I can send a short background summary to make it easy.

Thanks,
[Name]

templates.name: Alumni or shared background — introduce yourself
templates.whenToUse: A verified school, former employer, or community connection provides a reason to approach.
templates.subject: Fellow [shared affiliation] — [Role] at [Company]
templates.message:
Hi [First name],

I noticed we both [verified shared background]. I’m [brief introduction], exploring [Role, linked] at [Company].

I recently [relevant achievement]. Your team’s work on [specific area] caught my attention because [concrete reason].

Would you be open to reviewing my background for a possible referral?

Thanks,
[Name]

templates.name: Founder or technical leader — demonstrate fit
templates.whenToUse: A small-company founder or technical leader directly influences hiring and there is a concrete technical connection.
templates.subject: [Relevant technical work] — interested in [Company]
templates.message:
Hi [First name],

I read [specific post, documentation, or announcement] about [Company’s technical problem].

I worked on [related problem], where I [contribution and result]. That experience seems relevant to [specific challenge], especially [brief technical connection].

Would you consider me for [Role or clearly defined engineering area]?

Thanks,
[Name]

templates.name: Follow-up — return to the original ask
templates.whenToUse: An existing thread has no response after the user’s chosen interval of several days. Stop on replies or opt-outs.
requiredEvidence: Verified send date and no reply or opt-out
templates.subject: Keep the existing thread
templates.message:
Hi [First name],

Following up on my note about [Role]. [One additional relevant fact or a concise reminder of fit.]

I’m still interested in [specific team/work]. [Repeat the original ask in one sentence.]

Thanks,
[Name]
